paragraphs.zh: INTERNATIONALER RECHERCHENBERICHT Angaben zu Veröffentlichur [illegible], die zur selben Patentfamilie gehören
paragraphs.en: INTERNATIONAL SEARCH REPORT Information on patent family members
paragraphs.notes: This page is the patent family annex (Anhang Patentfamilie) to the international search report drawn up for PCT/EP99/06627. It is examiner-authored form matter appended to the publication and is NOT part of the disclosure: it carries none of the applicant's description, claims or examples. doc_part is set to description only because the schema offers no search-report value. Unlike the search report sheets earlier in the document, which are printed in English, this annex is the German-language form. The subtitle is broken in the scan: the word prints as 'Veröffentlichur' followed by a blank gap before the comma, where the form text is 'Veröffentlichungen'. Transcribed as printed with an [illegible] marker rather than reconstructed. This page carries no printed page number anywhere, so no printed-page-number-to-PDF-page mapping can be recorded for it.

Boxed field at the top right. The label is faded in the middle: it reads 'Interr' then a gap then 'nales Aktenzeichen', where the form text is 'Internationales Aktenzeichen'. The application number itself is crisp.

First table row, cells separated by ' | ', one family member per line, the two leading empty cells repeated as printed (blank in the scan). A small ink speck sits immediately left of the date 10-03-1992; it is scanning dirt, not a character. Bibliographic data only, no German prose, so zh and en are the same string.
Second table row. Bibliographic data only, no German prose, so zh and en are the same string.
Third table row. 'KEINE' is the form's German word for no family members found; it is printed in the family-member column and the publication-date column is blank.

Fourth table row, 21 family members in country-code alphabetical order. The CN entry carries two kind codes printed as 'A,B'. The two DE entries share the number 68923088 and differ only in kind code, D and T. Bibliographic data only, no German prose, so zh and en are the same string.
Fifth table row. 'KEINE' is the form's German word for no family members found.

Sixth and last table row, closed by a dashed rule. Unlike the previous long family this list is not in country-code alphabetical order as printed: AU, CA, WO, EP, JP. Recorded in the printed order. Bibliographic data only, no German prose, so zh and en are the same string. Below this rule the remainder of the page, roughly the bottom third of the form box, is blank.
